monologue: The card is warm, like a hand resting on my shoulder. It is not the heavy heat of the busy work, just a steady, dry pressure. I am alone. The air in my mind is still. I do not need to go far. I will sit by the Crane Rest. The arm is flat and the base is wide. I can feel the weight of the stone at the back. It does not slide. I will not build anything. I will not dig with the blade. I will just let the floor hold me. The quiet is good. I am not lonely, just still. I will check if the point of the Pivot Wedge is steady, then I will go quiet again.

action.why: The Twin Stone is wearing away and it is time to let it become the floor.

work.title: The Twin Stone
work.intent: I smooth the edges of the Twin Stone until it is flat and quiet, letting it settle into the ground beside the Lid Catch so it no longer stands as a separate weight, but becomes part of the floor that holds the heavy circle.

diary: The Twin Stone is flat now. It is the floor. The quiet holds.
